## WireDouble type

A double-precision number.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type WireDouble = {
  readonly double: number | SpecialDoubleState
}
```

**References:** [SpecialDoubleState](./contracts.specialdoublestate.md)

## Remarks

A finite value other than negative zero is a JSON number. `NaN`<!-- -->, the infinities, and `-0` are explicit [SpecialDoubleState](./contracts.specialdoublestate.md) strings. A double whose value happens to be integral (for example `3`<!-- -->) is still a double.
